outcome.technical: R7: _loader imports only _output, so it moved down. _deps.LAYERS gives it a layer of its own directly above _output. _usage_core now imports _loader, and _load_hooks_config_module calls _loader.load_hooks_config / _loader.load with cache=False; its raw importlib copy and the 'importlib.util' import are deleted. KNOWN_LAYER_DEBT's message moved to (layer 9) from layer 7, because every layer number shifted by one. The module map in PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md was regenerated with _deps.py --write-map. A paragraph was added to the _loader docstring and to the guide's _loader section saying why it may import nothing but _output. R9: usage_ledger.scan_transcripts writes rateVia='_default' on a row only when the rate is not None and _core._rate_via(model, pricing) answers '_default'. _rate_via stays private: usage_ledger reaches it through 'import _usage_core as _core', because rx3 pins the from-import list to public names. _usage_economics.rate_basis_phrase gained _default_clause(viaDefault, viaDefaultModels): '; N row(s) priced at the table's declared _default rate, not one named for their model (m1, m2)'. R4: the label now lives only in usage_ledger, as CLI_BASIS_METER, CLI_BASIS_TRANSCRIPT, CLI_BASIS_UNTAGGED and cli_basis(source). These are plain constants plus a function: a dict of them tripped gate-parity's reason-table classifier (p0/ea1). The comparison body moved out of _panel_usage._cli_cost_payload into usage_ledger.cli_cost_entries(ledger_dir, rows). The panel wrapper keeps its fail-soft [] and _CLI_BASIS is deleted. audit-usage._cli_basis is deleted and calls ul.cli_basis(cost_state.get('source')). _usage_load.load_usage carries 'cliCost' through _cli_cost(), which gives None if the comparison raises, so one failure does not blank the whole section. _report_usage._cli_cost_block renders it under the context line. It prints nothing with showCost off or when nothing differs. On None it prints a line saying the figure could not be compared. usage-view.js appends browseCliNote('model') under its context line, reusing the browse dialog's one rendering. Tests: the economics suite (68 cases) passes, test__report_usage passes (110), and vitest passes (821 tests across 55 files), including two new tab cases in usage-edges.test.mjs. Also passing: test__deps 320, test__usage_core 112, test_usage_ledger 126, test_audit_usage 181, test__panel_usage 43, test__usage_load 30, test__loader 32, test_meter_usage 62, test__panel_page 490 and test__panel_ui 89. ruff and vermin are clean. bench-hooks --gate passes. check-rendered-artifacts --before-commit: 'OK: 3 committed artifact(s) match a fresh render'. The full sweep and the cp1252 pass both exit 1 on the same file, plugins/audit/tests/test__refs.py, at the same two cases, sc1 and sc2. Those cases fail because the panel source digest moved with usage-view.js, which makes every committed panel screenshot stale: panel-appearance, panel-blocks, panel-composition-expanded, panel-composition, panel-confirm, panel-dark, panel-gate, panel-guards, panel-help, panel-mobile, panel-monthly, panel-overview, panel-person, panel-policy-expanded, panel-policy, panel-proposals and panel-usage (.png under docs/screenshots/). Capturing them is the orchestrator's job. sh examples/report.sh re-rendered examples/acme-store/acme-store-audit.{html,md} and docs/index.html, but only the 'generated' timestamp changed: the example ledger has no cursor with cliCost. docs/demo-large.html already matched a fresh render, so it was not rewritten. Gaps: the report's Markdown twin (_usage_markdown.py) does not carry the CLI line, because that file is outside this task's files. The None 'could not be compared' branch of _cli_cost_block has no case. Finding: PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md prose carries many numeric layer mentions ('layer 6', 'Layer 2', ...). layer_mention_drift() does not scan them, and they were already off by one before this change: _live_copy reads 'layer 6' while HEAD's map put it at L7. This change shifts them by one more. I did not fix them here.
outcome.descriptive: The shipped price table now loads through the shared loader. Rows a declared _default priced are stamped and counted in the rate phrase. The report and the panel's Usage tab now print the CLI's own estimate beside the plugin's figure, with its label kept in one place.
